description: Source code for reftable merged table implementation, including iterator management, merging logic, and table initialization functions.

classes.name: merged_subiter
classes.description: Structure representing a sub-iterator within the merged table, holding an iterator and a record.

classes.name: merged_iter
classes.description: Structure managing multiple sub-iterators and a priority queue for merging.

methods.name: merged_iter_close
methods.description: Closes and releases resources associated with a merged_iter.

methods.name: merged_iter_advance_subiter
methods.description: Advances a specific sub-iterator within the merged_iter.

methods.name: merged_iter_seek
methods.description: Seeks all sub-iterators to a specific record.

methods.name: merged_iter_next_entry
methods.description: Retrieves the next merged entry from the combined iterators.

methods.name: merged_iter_next_void
methods.description: Retrieves the next record, skipping deletions if specified.

methods.name: iterator_from_merged_iter
methods.description: Initializes a reftable_iterator from a merged_iter.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_new
methods.description: Creates a new merged reftable from multiple tables.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_max_update_index
methods.description: Returns the maximum update index of the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_min_update_index
methods.description: Returns the minimum update index of the merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_hash_id
methods.description: Returns the hash ID of the merged table.

methods.name: merged_table_init_iter
methods.description: Initializes an iterator over a merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_init_ref_iterator
methods.description: Initializes a reference iterator over a merged table.

methods.name: reftable_merged_table_init_log_iterator
methods.description: Initializes a log iterator over a merged table.
